subject.title: fix(config): fall back to provider-level contextWindow/maxTokens in model defaults

question: Should the canonical fix cover only the two fields reported in the issue, or complete the documented three-field provider token-default invariant before merge?
rationale: Both open PRs fix the reported failure, but they differ on `contextTokens`; choosing the permanent config contract and canonical branch requires maintainer intent because it affects compatibility-visible model materialization.

options.title: Complete all three defaults
options.body: Extend the selected branch to inherit `contextTokens` alongside `contextWindow` and `maxTokens`, then close the competing PR after comparison.

options.title: Land the focused fix
options.body: Merge this two-field branch and explicitly track provider-level `contextTokens` as a separate follow-up so the remaining documented gap is not lost.

options.title: Select the broader branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807 as the canonical candidate if its broader implementation and proof pass review, then close this PR as superseded.

recommendation.title: Complete all three defaults
recommendation.body: Extend the selected branch to inherit `contextTokens` alongside `contextWindow` and `maxTokens`, then close the competing PR after comparison.
